evidence.quote: Cyklop was established in 1912 and today, is a leading global provider of packaging machinery and supplies. || Now, with more than 1,200 employees in 24 countries, and over 500 patents, Cyklop is well-equipped to address its customers’ packaging needs seamlessly, efficiently and reliably. || Industries Food & Beverage Logistics Paper & Corrugate Pet Food Automotive Horticulture Chemical Construction Lumber Cosmetics Electronics Pharmaceutical
